Protecting Access to Spiritual Treatment and Organized Religion Act of 2026 or the PASTOR Act of 2026

This bill requires, as a condition of Medicare participation, health care providers to allow a clergy member access to a patient upon the patient's designation and request.

title: Protecting Access to Spiritual Treatment and Organized Religion Act of 2026
